title: Andy Hall's article supporting the chemical-plant hypothesis

tellings.quote: And he wrote a huge not a paper but a post on his website um basically an article um uh exposing the virtues of my work and corroborating why they are chemical manufacturing facilities that are powered by Earth's electricity.

plain: A writer named Andy Hall, linked to the Thunderbolts Project, a group that argues electricity shapes the universe, is said to have written a long article on his website backing the idea that the pyramids were chemical manufacturing plants powered by the Earth's electricity. Geoffrey Drumm, the researcher who proposed that idea, tells this himself, saying the article praised his work and gave reasons it was right.
